task-reply.title: Assistant reply
task-reply.intro: Generate a real reply from the selected model. Reply text does not execute commands or approve work.
task-reply.invalid_read: The reply response could not be verified. Refresh the original task context.
task-reply.refresh_failed: The current reply basis could not be refreshed. Your original request is preserved.
task-reply.access_changed: Access has changed. Protected reply details are hidden.
task-reply.pending_hint: The original request may already have started. Check the same operation; do not create another one.
task-reply.locator_unavailable: This reply is saved on the server, but its local shortcut could not be saved.
task-reply.requested: Reply execution requested. Completion is shown from the original execution.
task-reply.stored: The verified reply is saved in the task discussion.
task-reply.save_note_first: Save or clear your note before asking the assistant. Read-only access cannot start a reply.
task-reply.no_turn: Post a task message before asking for a reply.
task-reply.basis_changed: The task or discussion has changed since this reply started. Its original context remains fixed.
task-reply.context_partial: {{included}} of {{total}} saved messages were included ({{first}}–{{last}}). Earlier messages were not sent.
task-reply.no_profile: No enabled, available reply agent is loaded. Configure a dedicated read-only model-gateway profile.
task-reply.context_hint: Send only the selected recent window plus the current task and requirement. Oversized context is rejected; it is not silently trimmed.
task-reply.consent: Send the selected context to this model and reserve its configured token and cost allowances.
task-reply.active_hint: An original reply is still active or awaiting reconciliation. New model execution remains blocked until it terminates.
task-reply.followup: This message already has a verified reply. Post a follow-up message to continue the conversation.
task-reply.hint.running: The original agent is generating a reply. No completion is inferred from elapsed time.
task-reply.hint.reconciling: Inspect the original execution. An unknown result must not start another model request.
task-reply.hint.cancelling: The stop request is recorded. Actual stopping must still be confirmed.
task-reply.hint.completed: The original result was verified and stored as a task message. Usage remains available in the original execution.
task-reply.hint.failed: The original attempt failed. Review its evidence before explicitly requesting another reply.
task-reply.hint.cancelled: The original execution has terminated. A new reply requires a new explicit request.
task-reply.target_excluded: Choose a recent-message window that includes the message being answered.
